title: The Bureau Escape Rooms
specs: Voted #1 escape room in the USA
Escape rooms use advanced technology with no locks or keys
Anyone under 15 must be accompanied by an adult (18 or older)
All participants must sign a waiver prior to mission briefing; under 18 requires parent/guardian waiver
Escape rooms are private to your group; game show private if booking for 12 guests; groups larger than 10 require multiple missions
Groups larger than 20 can contact events team for arrangements

blurb: Guests play as agents in immersive escape rooms with unique storylines and technology-driven puzzles. They can also participate in a live game show with trivia and physical challenges or enjoy private karaoke and game rooms. The venue offers group events and parties with customizable experiences.
